sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Replaced the legacy `Name_Comment`/`Name_Comment_Artists`/`Name_Date_Comment` column extractors with `features.extractMainColumn` (matching the generic "MB-Name"/"Comment"/"MB-Primary alias" shape already used by `report-detail`) on `user-ratings-type`, `user-ratings`, `user-tag-value-entity`, `user-tag-value`, and `tag-value`. `extractMainColumn` is read-only against the native entity cell, so the original column is never mutated. Two new small, read-only companion extractors — `eventDate` (the trailing date after an Event's entity link) and `artistCredit` (the artist credit after "by" on Release/Release group/Recording) — restore the extra columns those legacy extractors also used to produce. `Name_Comment`, `Name_Comment_Artists`, `Name_Date_Comment`, and the (now-unused) `primaryAlias` extractor were deleted as dead code. `instrument-list` (`Name_Comment_Description`) is untouched — instruments cannot have a MusicBrainz primary alias. No change to `_extractMainColumnParts()` itself.

Fixed a header/cell-count-mismatch bug in `renderGroupedTable`'s per-group `<thead>` build for `tag-value`/`user-tag-value`/`instrument-list`: `activeColumnExtractors.find(e => e.sourceColumn === group.colName)` only resolved `colIdx` for the first `columnExtractors` entry when a group declared two or more entries on the same `sourceColumn`, silently dropping that entry's header (row extraction, run earlier, already resolved every matching entry, so its cell still got appended) — a `.forEach()`-based resolver now sets `colIdx` on every matching entry, matching the pattern already used everywhere else in the file.

Fixed the same class of header/cell-count mismatch on `user-ratings`'s Artist/Label/Place/Work ratings sub-tables: their per-group `<thead>` build only called `cleanupHeaders()` (which injects the MB-Name/Comment/MB-Primary-alias headers) when the group declared its own non-empty `entityFeatures`, but `extractMainColumn` is a page-level feature applying to every group uniformly — every row still grew 3 MB-Name/Comment/MB-Primary-alias `<td>`s regardless. `cleanupHeaders()` (and the colIdx re-resolution feeding it) now runs unconditionally for every group, matching the tag-value/user-tag-value/instrument-list per-group thead path.

Restored a `_synthColTooltip` case for `Name_Comment_Description` (the `instrument-list` extractor) describing its Name/Comment/Description columns — previously fell through to the generic per-extractor fallback tooltip.

Reordered the Events `columnExtractors` from `[eventDate, cancelledEvent]` to `[cancelledEvent, eventDate]` everywhere both appear, so the "Cancelled" column renders before "Date". Also added the `cancelledEvent` extractor to `tag-value`/`user-tag-value`'s Events blocks, which previously only had `eventDate` — bringing all five page types' Events blocks in line.

Migrated `tag-value-entity` off the `tagCount_*` extractor family onto the same `features.extractMainColumn` design as the other five page types, fixing the same missing-primary-alias gap those had (`tagCount_*` never surfaced a primary alias, just silently stripped it out of Comment). Reused `eventDate`/`artistCredit` unchanged for Date/Artist, and added one new small read-only companion extractor, `tagCount`, for the leading integer tag-vote count. `tagCount_Name_Comment`, `tagCount_Name_Comment_Artists`, and `tagCount_Name_Date_Comment` were deleted as dead code; `_tagCountBase` stays (still used by `Name_Comment_Description` for `instrument-list`).

Consolidated 10 of the 11 `*-aliases` page definitions (`instrument-aliases`, `area-aliases`, `place-aliases`, `series-aliases`, `label-aliases`, `work-aliases`, `releasegroup-aliases`, `release-aliases`, `recording-aliases`, `event-aliases`) — byte-for-byte identical apart from the entity name — into a single `entity-aliases` entry, using the existing `labelFromPathEntity` button-label mechanism to keep each page's "Show all Aliases for `<Entity>`" wording (release-group's label now reads "Release group" instead of the previous "Releasegroup"). This also fixes a real bug: all 10 were missing the `localeParts` columnExtractor that `artist-aliases` already had, so their alias tables' Locale column never got split into "Locale language"/"Primary locale" — now fixed for all of them at once. `artist-aliases` is left untouched (its `/artist/<mbid>/aliases` page has a second "Artist credits" section, needing two buttons with their own `targetHeader`/`tableMode` — a shape nothing else shares).
